name: Lord's Taverners TAFE NSW grants (North Coast)
summary: Urgent grants of $500 to $1,500 for TAFE NSW students on the North Coast facing hardship.
who: Doing an apprenticeship or relevant vocational course at TAFE NSW.
North Coast Institute area, from Kingscliff to Port Macquarie (originally Richmond Valley).
Priority to students facing challenges such as disability, unemployment, homelessness, transport barriers, domestic violence, a non-English-speaking background or sole parenthood.
how: Apply through TAFE with a teacher's support.
catches: TAFE NSW advertises the grants twice a year; no dates are listed.

source.label: Lord's Taverners Northern NSW: TAFE NSW Grants

evidence.quote: All applications must be made through TAFE and supported by a teacher.
TAFE NSW will advertise the grants twice a year.
